scenarios.name: power-counts-every-artifact-you-control
scenarios.why: The Vertibird's power is equal to the number of artifacts I control; with the Vertibird plus two other artifacts, its power is 3 and its toughness is the printed 4.

scenarios.name: crew-two-animates-the-vehicle
scenarios.why: Crew 2 taps creatures with total power 2 or greater and makes the Vehicle an artifact creature; with two artifacts controlled its power is 2, so it is a 2/4 creature.
